mapper.sql: s.id, s.agent_id, a.agent_code as agent_code, s.cron, s.enabled, s.xxl_job_id, s.payload_template_json, s.created_by, s.updated_by, s.created_at, s.updated_at
mapper.update: update agent_schedule set cron = #{cron}, payload_template_json = #{payloadTemplateJson}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
update agent_schedule set enabled = #{enabled}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update agent_schedule set xxl_job_id = #{xxlJobId}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from agent_schedule s left join agent a on a.id = s.agent_id where s.id = #{id} limit 1
select from agent_schedule s left join agent a on a.id = s.agent_id where s.agent_id = #{agentId} limit 1
